en: Black‑and‑white view over a calm river with a multi‑arch stone bridge in the middle ground. On the right bank stand several town houses and trees; on the left bank are industrial‑looking buildings with a tall chimney. Rising steeply behind the bridge is a rocky, wooded hill crowned by a large, fortified castle complex with high walls and a steep roof. The entire scene is reflected clearly in the water. The image has blank margins and surface blemishes typical of early photographic postcards. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
